description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended selpercatinib, within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating advanced RET fusion-positive thyroid cancer that is refractory to radioactive iodine (if radioactive iodine is appropriate), in people 12 years and over whose cancer has not been treated with a targeted cancer drug. Selpercatinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS.
